views.constrains: Outer silhouette profile (radius vs height) and vertical extent

parts.description: Single watertight vessel body with flared rim, neck, shoulder, and base

features.description: Top flared opening of the vase
Narrow cylindrical section below the rim
Widest part of the vase body

relations.description: The 2D silhouette is revolved 360 degrees around the vertical axis to create the 3D volume

dimensions.size_provenance: measured ink spans x authoritative max dimension

uncertainties: Wall thickness is not specified; assumed solid for 3D printing unless hollowing is applied.
Exact curvature of the shoulder and neck is inferred from the single silhouette.
generation_notes: The input is a single silhouette of a Greek vase. The geometry is interpreted as a surface of revolution. The profile is extracted from the front view, mirrored across the vertical axis, and revolved 360 degrees around the Z-axis. The maximum dimension (height) is scaled to 120mm.

unresolved_constraints: Wall thickness is not specified; assumed solid for 3D printing unless hollowing is applied.
Exact curvature of the shoulder and neck is inferred from the single silhouette.

user_intent.description: Greek vase from a single silhouette

multi_view_contract: All source views constrain one shared physical object; never instantiate views as separate geometry.
cutout_policy: Closed internal profiles are subtractive through-cutouts unless explicitly classified otherwise.
